# Security Policy

Nakoda runs locally and starts coding agents on your machine, so security reports matter.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue**. Report it privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/danangace/Nakoda/security/advisories/new). Include what you found, how to reproduce it and the impact.

You can expect an acknowledgement as soon as the maintainer can respond, and a fix or mitigation for confirmed issues.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on `main` (currently `v0.1.0-beta`) is supported.
